column1: # HD world pack: textures always built, whatever their screen coverage (tools/hdworld/build_world.py).
# Diagon Alley (user report after beta f62594f: white brick walls, buttress columns and steps by
# Gringotts look soft; the coverage walks do not get that far down the street): every mipmapped
# texture >= 64 px the level binds (probe log from frame 600 of Diagon Alley runs) that no other
# sampled level binds and the coverage top 200 does not already hold. Faces/posters included.
